key_insight: A DVAE plus particle filter can learn and track weld-pool state robustly across different arc welding processes without process-specific tuning.
engineering_relevance: This offers a scalable path to real-time weld monitoring that is less dependent on large labeled datasets and more resistant to arc glare, reflections, and other disturbances.
method: Unsupervised DVAE learns compact latent features from weld-pool images.
CNN encoder-decoder extracts spatial structure while an LSTM transition model captures time evolution under control inputs.
Particle filter propagates latent and hidden states to preserve history and suppress sensor noise.
evidence_signal: The framework was validated on GTAW and GMAW and showed generalizability and robustness without process-specific tuning.
watch_item: Performance may depend on stable image acquisition and careful particle-filter setup, especially when disturbances or motion dynamics differ from the validated cases.
paper_title: Robust Monitoring of Arc Welding Processes: A Generalizable Framework with DVAE and Particle Filter
